headline: Approved June 18, 2026 meeting minutes and accepted AMR activity and CQI reports through July 2026
summary: The Ambulance Advisory Committee approved the minutes from its previous meeting and accepted AMR's activity and CQI summary reports through July 2026. Members also discussed current Emergency Room diversion protocols, but no action was recorded on that topic.
decisions: Accepted the AMR activity and CQI summary reports through July 2026.

decision_evidence.quote: A motion was made by Kevin Blinn to accept the June 18, 2026 meeting minutes....The minutes were approved.
Al Gardella presented to accept the AMR reports....The AMR reports were accepted.

    Ambulance Advisory Committee Meeting Minutes 
Thursday, August 20, 2026 
Meeting held at 177 Lake Street in the 2nd Floor Conference Room 
Co-Chaired by Adam Pouliot and Fire Chief Steve M. Buxton 
 
The meeting was called to order at 3:04 p.m. by Adam Pouliot. 
 
AAC Members Present: 
                                                
Steve Buxton (NFR), Adam Pouliot (NFR), Chris McCarthy (PHEPC), Clark 
Gaphardt (NPD), Stacey Carroll (SNHMC),Kevin Blinn (SJH)

Approval of Previous Minutes:  
 
• A motion was made by Kevin Blinn to accept the June 18, 2026 meeting 
minutes. 
• The motion was seconded by Clark Gaphardt. 
• The minutes were approved.

• Al Gardella presented the CQI summary report provided by AMR. 
• Al Gardella presented to accept the AMR reports. 
• The AMR reports were accepted.
